payloads.author: quer3q
payloads.description: A toolkit for working with PS5 game dumps

payloads.name: PS5 Dump Forge
payloads.author: quer3q
payloads.release_notes:
## New

- **ampr-emu-ng v0.2.0.** The bundled ampr-emu-ng is now its v0.2.0 release. Games carrying v0.1.0 are still recognized. The AMPR tile shows the runtime and its version.
- **Custom packing rules.** zstd and LZ4 Pack take a TOML profile that decides which files are packed and which stay loose: the Pack tab's Custom rules fold, or CLI `--pack-profile`. The file can be on this device, a paired device or a saved NAS. See `docs/packing.md`.
- **Smarter built-in packing.** Protected and video folders match in any case, Insomniac's sound and movie containers stay loose, and the job log says why each group of files stays loose.

## Fixes

- Much faster with many small files: inspecting Gran Turismo 7 (95,382 files) on Windows went from 185-430 s to 4-5 s, and folder outputs write small files on 4 threads.
- A folder output writes `sce_sys/` and `eboot.bin` last, so ShadowMount+ never finds a half-written game.
- A packed game whose packs also hold a file that is on disk (LZ4 or zstd) is no longer refused: an identical copy keeps the plain file, otherwise the packed copy is used.

## Thanks

- @LuanQuanzTeixeira made their first contribution in #17: scanned files are opened for their attributes only on Windows, behind the much faster inspection above.
payloads.description: A toolkit for working with PS5 game dumps

payloads.name: PS5Upload

payloads.release_notes:
- **A friend's buttons hide right away on a phone.** When a friend joins, the TV asks who's
  using their controller; until someone picked a user, the card with the buttons stayed in the
  middle of a phone's screen with no way to hide it. It now shows the ask once, and **Hide** (or
  press and hold) puts it away at once.
- **Full screen is easy to reach for a friend on a phone.** Joining inside the app on a phone,
  the game's buttons crowded the small picture. They now sit in a bar under it, with a big
  **Full screen** button, sound and **Leave**, and turning the phone sideways goes full screen,
  as the host's player does.
- **Friends' PS button works by default.** A friend's PS and Create buttons (and holding PS)
  now reach the PS5 like the host's. To stop a stray press pulling everyone out of the game,
  turn on **Block PS & Create for friends** in the Play Together panel.

payloads.release_notes:
**Y2JB Autoloader X 1.1.2**, based on [Y2JB Autoloader v1.1.0](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-y2jb-autoloader/releases) by PLK.
Loads [Payload Manager X](https://github.com/bsk193/ps5-payload-manager-x) (port 8084) instead of the official Payload Manager.
payloads.description: Installs or updates Y2JB Autoloader X without FTP: opens the PS5 browser, shows each YouTube region (PPSA01650 US / PPSA01651 EU / PPSA01652 JP) and what it has now, then downloads the latest download0.dat into the one you pick.
